comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Confirmed in network panel: complaint form omits tenant_id, admin page sends it. Fix queued for next billing sprint.

content.text: Confirmed in network panel: complaint form omits tenant_id, admin page sends it. Fix queued for next billing sprint.

When filing a billing double-charge complaint, agents cannot attach the matching invoice ID from the search picker. Typing a known invoice number such as inv_7c18a9 returns "No invoices found" even though the same ID opens correctly from the billing admin page.

Expected: picker queries invoices for the ticket's tenant and lets the agent bind invoice_id on the complaint record. Actual: the picker always searches the agent's home workspace tenant, not the ticket customer tenant, so cross-tenant billing tickets never resolve IDs.
Likely a missing tenant_id query param on GET /billing/invoices/search when invoked from the complaint form; the admin page passes it explicitly.
